<includeonly>{{main other|{{#invoke:Settlement short description|main}}|}}{{Infobox
| child = {{yesno|{{{embed|}}}}}

| 0 = {{#if:{{{pushpin_map_narrow|}}}|{{#if:{{both| {{{pushpin_map|}}} | {{{coordinates|}}} }}|
{{location map|{{{pushpin_map|}}}
